about: The Python port's intended differences against the agentcc 1.0.0 golden that still wait for a reviewer record, for the comparison py-agentcc-1.0.0->e-new-py only. An entry lands here first with status 'landed' (evidence and test_id filled, reviewer null) and moves into the golden's tests/fixtures/gateway/intended-differences.json as 'proven' once an independent review signs it (by, commit, verdict); this list contains only entries still awaiting that review. Ids are new: '-py' splits of the golden's D-xx work list, 'PY-*' for port changes without a D number. scripts/gateway/compare_enew.py reads the port's entries from both files and requires 0 unlisted differences and every rule used. Every rule pins its value with an anchored regex of the observed value (the futureagi version generalised); a glob path appears only where every difference it matches has that same value change. The signed entries' rules are derived from the e-new-py recording at the commit named in 'recorded_at'; each landed entry's evidence names its own recording.

differences.summary: New errors in fi.gateway for the gateway's billing and budget refusals, chosen by (status, error.code), never error.type: InsufficientCreditsError (402 managed_credits_exhausted / managed_credits_insufficient) and AgentBudgetExhaustedError (402 agent_budget_exhausted), both APIStatusError subclasses, and BudgetExceededError (429 budget_exceeded / org_budget_exceeded), a RateLimitError subclass so an existing except RateLimitError still catches it. Each carries error.metadata as .metadata with its fields as properties and survives pickling without the response. fi.gateway._retry_policy.classify_refusal holds every class and retry decision. The 17 released errors keep their class, attributes, str, repr and pickling.
differences.evidence: golden surface.all, surface.modules <root>, _exceptions and _retry_policy, surface.signatures, surface.errors
